The wastewater undergoes biological treatment in the oxidation ditch
followed by solids separation in the secondary clarifier.
Effluent is chlorinated using sodium hypochlorite solution and dechlorinated using a sodium bisulfite prior to discharge.
The Facility also maintains a 4-million-gallon overflow storage pond with a synthetic liner
the remaining portion is pumped to one of six drying beds, dried, and placed in trash bins
hauled away by a contractor... to the Allied Waste Imperial Landfill (Imperial, CA) for disposal.
